name: Frostfang Pass
opening: An avalanche roars down and seals the road behind you. Ahead, a thick plume of smoke pours from a cave mouth in the cliff, and the snow leading to it is full of clawed footprints far too big to be human. From inside the cave comes a loud sneeze, and a puff of warm smoke rolls out.
picture: medium shot, (the hero standing at the dark mouth of a cave in a snowy cliff, a thick plume of smoke pouring out, huge clawed footprints in the snow:1.25), (snowy mountain pass:1.1), pink dawn light
background: a snowy mountain pass with the dark mouth of a cave in a cliff and smoke drifting out
beats: Survive the cold and reach the cave
Meet whoever lives in the smoking cave
Find another way down the mountain
style: icy white snow, cold dawn pink
secret: A young dragon lives in the cave, and it is more scared of you than you are of it.

cast.the young dragon: a small frost-blue dragon with big golden eyes and stubby wings
